coverImage.caption: Living chimpanzees combine climbing and terrestrial movement with occasional upright posture.

coverImage.alt: A translucent European lancelet showing its narrow fish-like chordate body
coverImage.caption: A living lancelet preserves a chordate body plan with small frontal photoreceptive organs.

journeys.title: From Light-Sensitive Cells to Vertebrate Eyes
